case.narrative: The Hyundai Tucson's "Consider taking a break" advisory is triggered by the Driver Attention Warning (DAW) system.  This warning happens so frequently that it is more than an annoyance, but a safety issue, because the driver must continually take their eyes off the road to examine what the vehicle is complaining about, and therefore could conceivably be the cause of a crash.  Dealer is aware of issue.  See attached technical service bulletin.  The problem is easily reproducible.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
